result_text:
The "Undefined Team" now only collects active contributors. I compiled `codeanalyzer`, but I didn't run any tests and I didn't add one for this.

The change is one condition in `getAllTeams()` in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`. The remainder branch now requires `contributor.getContributor().isActive()` as well as no team match. Unmatched contributors whose latest commit is older than the 180-day threshold are left out.

- **Blank dates:** `Contributor.isActive()` goes through `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange`, which already returns true for a blank date. Those contributors stay in the remainder, so no extra handling was needed.
- **Configured teams:** that code path is untouched, so they keep all their members, active or not.
